2609.24903.title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
2609.24903.paper_summary: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.
2609.24903.paper_summary_zh: 語調語言佔全球語言的50-70%以上，但絕大多數是低資源語言，缺乏自動語調分類所需的大量轉錄語料庫。現有數據集通常在句子層面收集，而田野語言學家需要細粒度的音節級註釋。我們提出了ToneCL，一個輕量級的對比學習框架，用於少量樣本的音節級語調分類。我們在普通話和越南語上模擬低資源條件，將標記數據限制為每個語調類別數十個示例。ToneCL在未標記語音上進行預訓練，並使用保持音調身份的增強技術，然後在少量樣本上進行微調。實驗顯示我們的方法始終優於基準，並在10個樣本的情況下，在六位講者的普通話上達到91.6%的準確率。跨語言轉移也有效：在越南語上進行預訓練，然後在普通話上進行微調，在10個樣本的情況下達到91.0%的準確率。消融實驗確認頻率帶拒絕是最關鍵的增強技術。
2609.24903.author: Qisheng Liao et.al.
